decision_summary: Implement v0.6.33 by extending calibration-report with executable Consequence Policy, Decision Consequence, and Consequence Assessment records.
rationale: Visionary: calibration should support decisions at explicit loss boundaries rather than stop at average error. Builder: the narrowest composable change derives action and consequence class from existing decision-outcome pairs and reviewed policies. Guardian: governance weights are local prioritization inputs, not money, objective harm, cross-policy utility, quality, or automatic authority; severe false assurance and unresolved policy review must route to governance.
recommendation: Add schema, example, deterministic verifier logic, retained negative fixtures, plain-language docs, roadmap, AOF evidence, and release.
target_audience: QIF users, AI agents, reviewers, operators, and governance owners
expected_user_reaction: Users can see why an overconfident failure is governed differently from a cautious false alarm while retaining explicit limits.
